scope: All original iPad 1.x touch interactions, including selection, gridding, zoom, XY control and simultaneous gestures.
completion_rule: Every confirmed target-build gesture must have matching reference and replica results. Unresolved presence must be resolved with evidence. Compilation, mouse tests, generic widgets and controller equivalents do not establish iPad parity.

gestures.current_implementation: Waveform-specific upward swipe opens browser without a deck-wide parent recognizer.
gestures.reference_trial: Swipe from original eligible regions; compare threshold, direction, cancellation and drawer animation.

gestures.current_implementation: Selection reveals an up-A/down-B slider. Release threshold and protection are development policies.
gestures.reference_trial: Select without loading; drag each way; reverse, abandon and repeat; test stopped, playing and queued destinations.

gestures.current_implementation: Native library browsing and selection exist; original collection search, sorting and playlist editing routes are unmatched.
gestures.reference_trial: Compare scrolling, selection retention, search, sort, edit ticks, playlist creation and dismissal without disturbing playback.

gestures.current_implementation: Artwork opens destination suggestions. Touch interaction is unverified.
gestures.reference_trial: Tap each destination artwork while either or both decks play; compare context and return selection.

gestures.current_implementation: Tap opens wheel; angular drag changes tempo with provisional scale and bounds.
gestures.reference_trial: Rotate through angle wrap in both directions; lift, recontact and use the other deck simultaneously.

gestures.current_implementation: Stripe navigation remains independent of source playback. A return-to-playhead button recentres preview without a seek or phase change.
gestures.reference_trial: Move the window during playback, release, then dismiss; compare audible position and restored viewport.

gestures.current_implementation: Native iPad contact arbitration separates stripe pinch from single-contact navigation; Mac trackpad fallback retained.
gestures.reference_trial: Pinch and spread the red window; compare anchor, bounds, navigation side effects and scale after mode changes.

gestures.current_implementation: Beat-tap jump reaches the audio renderer and schedules against the selected quantum.
gestures.reference_trial: Inspect another region and tap a beat; compare acceptance, quantisation, audible jump and view follow.

gestures.current_implementation: Paused drag retains selected source position; playing drag uses temporary touch commands and optional Flux return.
gestures.reference_trial: Drag while playing and paused; compare source motion, sound, snap and release with Flux on/off.

gestures.current_implementation: Grid drag uses contact lifecycle; cancellation restores the original draft/view. Extra contacts cancel an uncommitted shift rather than applying an unresolved pinch mapping.
gestures.reference_trial: Enter grid edit, move waveform against grid, release and leave; compare phase, viewport, playback and saved state.

gestures.current_implementation: Four downbeat buttons and half/double/tap exist with uncalibrated touch details.
gestures.reference_trial: Select each downbeat and correct tempo; compare bar origin, tap timing, precision and cue/loop effects after reload.

gestures.gesture: Grid pinch, snapping and four-beat inspection
gestures.current_implementation: Four-beat inspection is documented for controllers. Grid pinch/snap semantics are not established.
gestures.reference_trial: Establish presence and touch mapping on target build; distinguish viewport zoom from BPM/grid-spacing changes.

gestures.gesture: Hotcue create, recall, delete and stored loops
gestures.current_implementation: A flag button opens eight persistent cue slots. Cue, loop and white grid-marker types are stored separately. New grid-marker allocation uses a provisional first-free policy; deliberate deletion survives reload. Saved-loop recall schedules jump and loop activation together.
gestures.reference_trial: Compare all slots, empty/occupied taps, deletion entry, cue types, quantisation, paused triggering and loop recall after reload.

gestures.current_implementation: Two contacts define a snapped loop region; default LOOP control is also available.
gestures.reference_trial: Touch two beat positions in both contact orders; compare endpoints, snapping, minimum separation and preset-loop interaction.

gestures.current_implementation: Two-contact centroid translation moves a loop in beat steps.
gestures.reference_trial: Hold both fingers and translate forward/back; compare retained length, movement steps, sound and file boundaries.

gestures.current_implementation: Contact separation resizes loop in power-of-two steps.
gestures.reference_trial: Pinch/spread an active loop; compare discrete lengths, retained anchor and transition into translation.

gestures.current_implementation: Two-finger downward dismissal from historical S24 commits after both releases; cancellation restores the prior loop. Exact target-build contact count, threshold and timing remain unverified.
gestures.reference_trial: Resolve dismissal contacts and timing; compare exit with Flux on/off and loops near track boundaries.
gestures.reference_review_note: S16 narrates a two-finger tap; S24 visually supports downward motion. Exact contacts, release timing and target 1.6.8 parity remain unresolved. No gesture change.

gestures.current_implementation: Freeze and Loop Slicer have eight visible slices, held audition, overlapping contacts, slice quantisation and Freeze on Load. Blank regions outside the file are ignored and cannot fall through to a seek.
gestures.reference_trial: Freeze while playing, tap/hold slices, vary zoom and move region; repeat inside a loop with each quantise setting and Freeze on Load.

gestures.current_implementation: Renderer retains continuing position and returns on temporary release or loop exit; multi-operation original ownership remains unverified.
gestures.reference_trial: Overlap scrub, cue, slice and loop holds; release in both orders and compare audible and continuing positions.

gestures.current_implementation: Three family selectors with three vertical action regions. Turntablism routes Brake/Scratch/Reverse; Pitch routes Pitch Up/Slice/Pitch Down. User-authorised provisional Loop Stutter repeats full/half/quarter playable slice, minimum one frame, at rate1. Twelve private offline checks passed before guarded integration. Curves, boundaries, release ownership and original repeat-length parity remain unverified.
gestures.reference_trial: Establish installed modes/unlock state; compare Scratch, Brake, Reverse, Slice and Pitch-shift zones, contacts and release.

confirmed: Three stacked family selectors and three vertical action regions
Turntablism: top Brake, middle Scratch, bottom Reverse
Pitch: top Pitch Up, middle Slice, bottom Pitch Down
reference_results.contextual_inference: First loop-arrow selector corresponds to the loop-stutter demonstration.
still_unverified: Loop-stutter lengths and dependence on slice size
Exact hit boundaries, curves, contact priority and release

gestures.current_implementation: Separate Equalizer/Filter tabs; vertical Low/Mid/High/Vol controls with centre reset and temporary second-contact values. Simultaneous release/cancellation restores the saved value. Original contact thresholds and temporary-contact policy remain unverified.
gestures.reference_trial: Open original drawer; drag bands and volume independently, tap centres, and test second-finger temporary values/release against reference.

gestures.current_implementation: XY touch engages cutoff/resonance; release bypasses when unlocked; Y persists.
gestures.reference_trial: Sweep X and Y separately/together; compare centre, edges, sound, initial contact, lift, bypass and restart.

gestures.current_implementation: Filter lock retains sound after release and drawer hiding; cancellation bypasses.
gestures.reference_trial: Lock during a held gesture; lift, hide/reopen drawer, unlock and recontact; compare sound and retained coordinates.

gestures.gesture: FX drawer, selection, XY and locks
gestures.current_implementation: Three selector tabs share one XY pad, following H5. Inactive tab selects; active tab opens the scrollable eleven-effect menu. Pad gestures retain their original slot until release. Eight base and three DLC names have independent DSP. Exact NI sound and mobile parameter curves remain unverified.
gestures.reference_trial: Open drawer, tap effect, hold/drag selector down, shape XY, lock/release and hide; compare slots, tail and persisted Y.

gestures.current_implementation: Crossfader and cue controls exist with independent mixer state; original gesture curves and action edges are unmatched.
gestures.reference_trial: Move fader while touching EQ/filter on either deck; compare cue toggles, monitor blend and control ownership.

gestures.current_implementation: Original Mac Z1 MODE+ON routes filter/FX per deck, ON toggles the selected effect, and knob X preserves Y during vertical touch. Synthetic reports and mode/touch ownership are tested. iPad accessory transport and physical takeover remain unfinished.
gestures.reference_trial: Move Z1 filter X while touching Y; compare feedback, takeover, mode changes and retained Y.

gestures.current_implementation: Recording and saved-set routes are implemented by main recreation work. A side Notification Center exposes eleven known lesson topics; original discovery/completion logic remains unimplemented.
gestures.reference_trial: Compare recording start/stop, saved-set selection/loading/export and gesture help entry/dismissal on target build.

gestures.current_implementation: Native contact identities, cancellation on removal/resize, loop cancellation and overlapping slice release have synthetic tests. Track/mode changes release audition and ignore old contacts until lift. Blank Freeze contacts and extra grid contacts cannot trigger unrelated actions.
gestures.reference_trial: Exercise both decks and overlapping controls; add/remove contacts, leave bounds, cancel touches, interrupt app and rotate during a hold. Compare reference outcomes without stuck controls or unintended actions.

additional_development_checks.scope: Synthetic grid contact, preview return, Freeze blank-region and loop release regressions.
Track/mode contact ownership and audition release.
Synthetic original Z1 routing, axis ownership and cue preservation.
Independent DLC DSP and base effect regressions; no original sound comparison.

queued_play_user_reference.question: What happens if Play is pressed again while an incoming synced deck waits to start?
queued_play_user_reference.scope: Direct user report of original Traktor DJ 1.x. Does not resolve other queued actions or Sync realignment.

implementation_review_2026_10_30.scope: Original requirements and observations are retained. Current implementation is tracked separately; an unresolved original policy is not an absent feature.
